thread.title: Frankfurt flights resume after being suspended for storm

title: Frankfurt flights resume after being suspended for storm
text:
Frankfurt flights resume after being suspended for storm Posted on Thursday, August 9th, 2018 By The Associated Press
BERLIN (AP) — Takeoffs and landings at Frankfurt Airport were briefly suspended on Thursday because of a thunderstorm.
Storms hit parts of Germany after a long spell of hot, dry weather.
